messages:
leo (cs): Post-onboard notes for Horizon Labs (PM: Maya). Key asks: per-route on/off switch in Console; exportable per-route cost CSV; bulk-embedding stability (timeouts during parallel uploads). They said renewal conversation in 18 days — cost visibility is gating.

anya (product): Thanks. Can you include exact error text or sample request? This could be an at-risk renewal.

leo (cs): Maya: "Uploads intermittently time out with 504 after sustained bursts, killing our ETL." Repro: 30k vectors split across 5 workers, concurrency spikes. I'll DM traces and job IDs.

katie (cs): Finance wants daily rows: date, route, tokens, cost_usd. They need a CSV to attach to renewal packet.

jun (eng): 504s suggest batching backlog or worker restart. @anya share traces. I'll check worker logs and retry/fallback counts.

anya (product): Creating ticket HL-3010. If UI toggle is small, Q2 quickship; otherwise enablement + CSV export as mitigation. Vote please.

notify-bot: HL-3010 created: horizonlabs-embed-cost-stability https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HL-3010

leo (cs): Marking account health = at-risk until we have a plan. Maya is okay with a workaround (limit concurrency + provide CSV) if we supply step-by-step.

katie (cs): I'll draft the enablement note + export script. Include curl snippet to reduce concurrency.

jun (eng): I'll post initial findings to HL-3010 within 24h. If fallback thrash is root cause, we may need runtime changes.

anya (product): Recap: HL-3010 triage (prod+eng), enablement CSV & template (CS), update account health (CS). Aim: mitigation note to customer within 48h.
